description:
Achillea Beauty is a progressive and sustainable skincare brand specifically dedicated to exercise. We are the first and only company to have developed a facial mist that gets activated by motion - increased heart rate, blood pumping close to the skin surface and open pores. This unique state of the skin during exercise is what we leverage in order to enhance the post workout glow, hydrate skin to maintain a youthful appearance and keep the pores clean and unclogged. 
We see ourselves as a truly unique brand, the first one that has developed a range of skincare products dedicated to exercise. There isn’t any other company in the market that leverages the state of the skin during workouts (increased heart beat, open pores, blood pumping closer to skin level, skin cells going into repair mode, sweat) to fight acne, aging and lack of glow through intelligent ingredients. Other companies that focus on exercise have developed make-up that stays in place and resists the changes at skin levels, but no one has focused on skincare and a pre, during and post workout beauty ritual. By reframing exercise as an act fuelled by nature that enhances skin health, Achillea could land as the fitness partner for the active eco-conscious consumers.

• USP (Unique Selling Point): 
Our exercise dedicated skincare ritual contains three products, all handmade, hand poured, vegan and sustainable. Our packaging is 100% recycled and further recyclable and we donate 10% of each sale towards planting trees. Our norm defying pouch that attaches and holds the hero spray to any size and shape water bottle is probably the most wonderful packing solution – made of leftover materials (fruit leather) – it’s an industry first that sees fruit waste as a precious starting material, eco-friendly, animal friendly, super cool and practical.
Our super active ingredients have been highly researched and tested, it took us over 3 years to perfect and test the formula and get it to the right stage. Our cocktail of potent actives has been sourced from around Europe (UK, Switzerland, Italy, Romania) and we are 100% transparent on the full list, being as close to natural, clean ingredients as possible. We use yarrow (Achillea Millefolium) in all our products due to its extraordinary properties (anti inflammatory, antimicrobial, moisturizing, soothing, purifying and anti-aging) – it’s like a magic wand in the ingredients’ world. It is also a local European plant, found in abundance across UK & Romania that attracts hundreds of pollinators and butterflies and it’s also an amazing benefactor for increasing soils’ nutrients and acting as a fertilizer for trees.
name: Achillea Beauty
